**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Kubient MSA contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant. I checked the confidentiality section (§12), the term/termination provisions, and all of the General Provisions (§14), and ran targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "no-hire", "recruit", "entice" and "induce … to leave" — all returned nothing. The only employee references are in the limitation of liability (§7), indemnities (§10) and confidentiality (§12), none of which restrict hiring or solicitation; nor is any such covenant picked up by the survival language in §14(f).

AP is therefore under no non-solicitation restriction, which meets our preferred position outright. No redline proposed — this outcome favours us. If Kubient raises a non-solicit in negotiation, we would hold to the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire element.
